| 1–38 | Sea-Ice Model Input Parameters / 머리와 입력 문법 — 저자·저작권·라이선스 주석을 포함한다(1–9). 키워드(keyword), `=`·`==`, 주석과 빈 줄 무시, 역슬래시 연속행, 부족한 배열값에 마지막 값 할당, 공백 없는 반복 지정 및 중첩 격자(nested grid)의 열 우선(column-major) 순서를 설명한다(11–35). 원문: `!` (1); `!  Sea-Ice Model Input Parameters` (2); `!` (3); `!git $Id$` (4); `!========================================================= Hernan G. Arango ===` (5); `!  Copyright (c) 2002-2026 The ROMS Group                                     !` (6); `!    Licensed under a MIT/X style license                                     !` (7); `!    See License_ROMS.md                                                      !` (8); `!==============================================================================` (9); `!                                                                             !` (10); `! Input parameters can be entered in ANY order, provided that the parameter   !` (11); `! KEYWORD (usually, upper case) is typed correctly followed by "="  or "=="   !` (12); `! symbols. Any comment lines are allowed and must begin with an exclamation   !` (13); `! mark (!) in column one.  Comments may appear to the right of a parameter    !` (14); `! specification to improve documentation.  Comments are ignored during        !` (15); `! reading.  Blank lines are also allowed and ignored. Continuation lines in   !` (16); `! a parameter specification are allowed if preceded by a backslash (\).  In   !` (17); `! some instances, more than one value is required for a parameter.  If fewer  !` (18); `! values are provided, the last value is assigned for the entire parameter    !` (19); `! array.  The multiplication symbol (*),  without blank spaces in between,    !` (20); `! is allowed for a parameter specification. For example, in two grids nested  !` (21); `! application:                                                                !` (22); `!                                                                             !` (23); `!    AKT_BAK == 2*1.0d-6  2*5.0d-6              ! m2/s                        !` (24); `!                                                                             !` (25); `! indicates that the first two entries of array AKT_BAK,  in fortran column-  !` (26); `! major order, will have the same value of "1.0d-6" for grid 1,  whereas the  !` (27); `! next two entries will have the same value of "5.0d-6" for grid 2.           !` (28); `!                                                                             !` (29); `! In multiple levels of nesting or multiple connected domains step-ups,       !` (30); `! "Ngrids" entries are expected for some of these parameters. In such case,   !` (31); `! the order of the entries for a parameter is critical. It must follow the    !` (32); `! same order (1:Ngrids) as in the state variable declaration. The USER may    !` (33); `! follow the above guidelines for specifying his/her values. These parameters !` (34); `! are marked by "==" plural symbol after the KEYWORD.                         !` (35); `!                                                                             !` (36); `!==============================================================================` (37); `!` (38). |
| 39–71 | Sea ice model parameters / EVP·밀도·항력·강도 — 탄성 점성 소성(Elastic-Viscous-Plastic, EVP) 유변학(rheology)의 탄성 단계 수를 지정한다(39–42). 공기·얼음·눈 밀도, 무차원 항력(drag) 계수, Hibler 강도 매개변수, 전단 강도 한계 및 항복 곡선(yield curve)의 제곱 타원율을 제시한다(44–70). 각 설정값과 단위 주석을 그대로 인용한다. 원문: `! | 106–140 | Lateral boundary conditions / 문법과 경계 코드 — 상태변수(state variable)별 배열 크기와 서·남·동·북 순서, 대소문자 비구분, 복합 `RadNud` 및 압축 입력 설명을 제시한다(106–121). 경계 조건(boundary condition) 코드 표와 ASCII 격자는 북쪽 4, 서쪽 1, 동쪽 3, 남쪽 2를 표시한다(123–139). 원문: `! Set lateral boundary conditions keyword. Notice that a value is expected` (106); `! for each boundary segment per nested grid for each state variable.` (107); `!` (108); `! The SeaIce Model state variables require [1:4,1:nIceS,Ngrids] values. The` (109); `! boundary order is: 1=west, 2=south, 3=east, and 4=north. That is,` (110); `! anticlockwise starting at the western boundary.` (111); `!` (112); `! The keyword is case insensitive and usually has three characters. However,` (113); `! it is possible to have compound keywords, if applicable. For example, the` (114); `! keyword "RadNud" implies radiation boundary condition with nudging. This` (115); `! combination is usually used in active/passive radiation conditions.` (116); `!` (117); `! NOTICE: It is possible to specify the lateral boundary conditions for` (118); `! ======  all biological tracers in a compact form with a single entry.` (119); `! The ROMS SeaIce Model ((Budgell, 2005; Durski and Kurapov, 2019, 2020)` (270); `! Parameters. | 342–378 | GLOSSARY / 경계 배열과 압축 입력 — 논리 스위치(logical switch)가 CPP 플래그(flag)를 대신하며 중첩 격자 구조 배열에 값을 넣는다고 설명한다(346–359). 복합 경계 코드와 압축 입력을 설명하고 예제 열 머리를 제시한다(361–377). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (342); `! Lateral boundary conditions parameters.` (343); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (344); `!` (345); `! The lateral boundary conditions are now specified with logical switches` (346); `! instead of CPP flags to allow nested grid configurations. Their values are` (347); `! load into structured array:` (348); `!` (349); `!    LBC(1:4, nLBCvar, Ngrids)` (350); `!` (351); `! where 1:4 are the number of boundary edges, nLBCvar are the number LBC state` (352); `! variables, and Ngrids is the number of nested grids. For Example, to apply` (353); `! gradient boundary conditions to any ice state variable we use:` (354); `!` (355); `!    LBC(iwest,  iSice(i), ng) % gradient` (356); `!    LBC(ieast,  iSice(i), ng) % gradient` (357); `!    LBC(isouth, iSice(i), ng) % gradient` (358); `!    LBC(inorth, iSice(i), ng) % gradient` (359); `!` (360); `! The lateral boundary conditions for ice state variables are entered with` (361); `! a keyword. This keyword is case insensitive and usually has three characters.` (362); `! However, it is possible to have compound keywords, if applicable. For example,` (363); `! the keyword "RadNud" implies radiation boundary condition with nudging. This` (364); `! combination is usually used in active/passive radiation conditions.` (365); `!` (366); `! It is possible to specify the lateral boundary conditions for all ice state` (367); `! variables in a compact form with a single entry.  for example, in a East-West` (368); `! periodic application we can just have:` (369); `!` (370); `!                   W       S       E       N` (371); `!                   e       o       a       o` (372); `!                   s       u       s       r` (373); `!                   t       t       t       t` (374); `!                           h               h` (375); `!` (376); `!                   1       2       3       4` (377); `!` (378). |

## 판독 중 확인된 사실 (판단 아님, 후속 검토 대상)

- 119–121·395–397: 해빙 경계 입력 설명에 대상 이름을 `biological tracers`로 적는다.
- 367–369·371–393: 원문은 동서 주기 적용을 소개한다. 서·남·동·북 열 아래의 실제 예제 값은 `Per     Clo     Clo     Per`이다. 예제는 서쪽과 북쪽 열에 `Per`를 둔다.
- 367–369·379–397: 원문은 `single entry`를 설명한다. 예제에는 `LBC(isAice)`부터 `LBC(isVevp)`까지 15개 입력행이 있다.
- 169·205·241·424·462·500: 앞 설정행의 `idTice` 설명은 `ice interior temperature`이다. 뒤 용어집의 같은 출력 항목 설명은 `surface temperature at snow/atmosphere interface`이다.
- 178·214·250·433·471·509: 앞 설정행의 `idIsst` 설명은 `ice surface temperature`이다. 뒤 용어집의 같은 출력 항목 설명은 `ice interior temperature (at ice mid-layer)`이다.
